title: A1 fixed behavior: 20 Spiders, 7 streams, original Task 15 acceptance rules
annotator: claude-sonnet-5.5 worker, hand annotation on 2026-10-24 (hand-reading by a language model; no human review; no program produced any expected value)
independence_statement: Every expected value below was typed by hand after reading the cited A1 files. No A2 or Kedro implementation code was imported or run. No script enumerated the Spiders; the list was read with a text search of 'name = ' lines and counted by eye, then cross-checked against two prose statements ('20 Spiders') in the A1 docs.

sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-a1-a2-handoff-contract-design.md: sections 'Acquisition stream', 12 'Seventeen-Spider release matrix', Teams extension table
provenance.what_was_read: Twenty Spider name attributes were found: 1 profile, 3 contacts, 3 OneDrive, 3 Teams, 4 Outlook mail, 4 Outlook calendar, 2 To Do. Seven AcquisitionStream members were found. The original Task 15 baseline is 17 Spiders (the 20 minus 3 Teams Spiders).

cases.title: Installed Spider inventory is exactly 20 names
cases.rationale: Counted by eye from the 'name = ' lines. Matches the prose count in a1-closeout.md and task15-final-qualification-20261016.md.

cases.title: Exactly 7 acquisition streams exist
cases.rationale: AcquisitionStream in handoff.py lists these 7 values. The handoff spec lists the same 7.

cases.title: Teams notification reconciliation adds no eighth stream
cases.rationale: Spec text: 'Teams notification reconciliation contributes to the two Teams streams; it does not create a third stream.'

cases.title: Profile Spider is operational output, not an A2 stream
cases.rationale: Spec: 'Profile output is operational output, not an A2 stream.' 20 minus profile gives 19 Spiders that can publish a release.

cases.title: Original Task 15 baseline is 17 Spiders; Teams adds 3 later
cases.rationale: Spec Teams extension table: 'No additional Task 15 scenario is inferred from their presence.'

cases.title: Streams advance independently even with one source ID
cases.rationale: Spec rejects 'one global A2 cursor' because one source ID can expose multiple streams. A2 consumer cursor is per catalog, source_id, stream and stable consumer identity.

cases.title: Claim of 17 installed Spiders is wrong

expected.reason: 17 is the original 2026-10-03 baseline, not the installed scope

cases.title: Claim of 8 streams (a Teams notification stream) is wrong
A2 plan may not rewrite A1 acceptance rules

input.proposal: A2 Kedro author redefines the A1 release gate or the 28-gate Task 15 qualification

cases.rationale: Spec non-goals: A2 does not mutate A1 rows as consumed, and A1 does not import A2. Task 15 closeout fixes the exact-SHA 28-gate result; A2 does not transfer or restate it.

cases.title: Live Teams tenant support may not be claimed from local fixtures

input.claim: Teams live tenant acceptance is proven

expected.reason: Live work/school tenant acceptance is explicitly out of scope; only local fixtures exist

cases.title: Insertion order may not imply provider chronology

input.claim: A1 SQLite row order is the provider event order

expected.reason: Spec non-goal: do not infer provider chronology from SQLite insertion order
